title: Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite index closes at 7,209.62 up 121.47 points
text:
Shutterstock photo Friday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index at 7,209.62. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.06 billion.
Advancers stocks led declining by 2.66 to 1 ratio. There were 2182 advancers and 820 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 67 stocks reached a 52 week high and 16 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed up 1.89% for the day; a total of 125.64 points. The current value is 6,769.12. Express Scripts Holding Company ( ESRX ) had the largest percent change down (-2.74%) while IDEXX Laboratories, Inc. ( IDXX ) had the largest percent change gain rising 8.39%.
The Dow Jones index closed up 1.39% for the day; a total of 332.36 points. The current value is 24,262.51. Chevron Corporation ( CVX ) had the largest percent change down (-.38%) while Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) had the largest percent change gain rising 3.92%.
